author: Saman J Nasur
title: Hiring Character Design Artist – Foundational Team (Paid)
content:
[Hiring] Character Design Artist – Foundational Team (Paid)
I am reopening the search for a talented Character Design Artist to join my foundational team and help build the aesthetic blueprint of this project from the ground up. This is a dedicated world-building and design phase role. Rather than stepping into a rigid production pipeline, your sole focus will be crafting a cohesive, expressive character identity from scratch.

Scope of Work:
Character Design: Creating distinct, expressive character concepts, wardrobe, and design sheets. Visual Development: Establishing the foundational look, feel, and personality of the cast to anchor the project's overall aesthetic.

What We Offer:
Fully paid role.
A structured, realistic production timeline focused on deliberate quality. The role has strong potential for long-term growth as the project expands.

Art Style Reference:
Check out the examples below to get a sense of the mood, tone, and visual direction we are aiming for

To Apply:
If you have professional experience in character design and want to help shape a new universe, please message me on Facebook first with your email address. From there, send your name, portfolio, and a brief introduction to OriginPointStudio1of1@gmail.com, and I will review everything later today. I'm looking forward to connecting with you!

title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
**Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator**
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
-work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!
